OnEnqueuePlayVfx.rationale: `NHellraiserVfx.Create(...)` plus `CreatureCmd.TriggerAnim(Owner.Creature, "PowerUp", ...)` (Hellraiser.cs:28-32). This is the one `public override` the harness enumerated for this unit and it is pure presentation -- a VFX node and an animation trigger, hoisted out of OnPlay into the enqueue-VFX slot so it plays while the card flies. No state is touched. Out of scope per the shared contract.

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Hellraiser.cs:18-21) == cost 2 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<HellraiserPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Hellraiser.cs:25) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, HellraiserPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Literal 1 on both sides. Note the C# OnPlay body carries NO animation call at all, because it was moved to OnEnqueuePlayVfx -- so the sim's bare one-liner is a complete match rather than an omission.
